about_the_game:
The First Multiplayer Horror VR game inspired by Phasmophobia.

👻Play with friends, laugh and run!

A game you work together to solve puzzles, explore creepy places & survive scary chases!

  • 3 HUGE MAPS: BigHouse, HighSchool, OldFactory. Wait for you!

  • 2 MODES: Easy Mode for beginners, Crazy Mode with 10 super-powered demons!

👻 Easy to play, can't stop screaming!

  • Find the Room: listen to whisper/find the floating stuffs.

  • So Many Tools: Pour holy water to track demons, hold a Bible let them away....

  • Catch the Evil: Match right tools & rush to the platform. Trap the demon!

  • Use Power-ups: Use a voice changer to talk like DonaldDuck, take pills to become devil, ring the bell to bring your friend alive. Don't let the devil kill you!

👻 Heart-pumping chases!

If you love games like Lethal Company\Animal Company. Or enjoy the environment of FNAF. This is your new favorite!

In Crazy Mode, demons kill when you are alone. RUN to your friends or get caught!

👻 Cool power-ups!

Want to make some fun? Use the speed-up lollipop to get rid of the chasing, take the pill to pretend to be a demon! You can blow on your controller to stop them!

Here are more...

👻 Dress up!

Be Creative! Unlock masks, and cool avatars! If you like Gorilla Tag or Yeeps' cosmetics, continue here!

You will have FNAF's Freddy bear mask, angel avatars...

Key Features:

  • Play with friends/Solo

  • Sandbox exploration

  • Daily/weekly missions

  • Run, hide, and survive

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA®GeForce® GTX 1650s / AMD Radeon™ RX5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR，requires motion controllers. Support Valve Index, Quest 2 and Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: VR Only
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA®GeForce® GTX 1650s / AMD Radeon™ RX5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR，requires motion controllers. Support Valve Index, Oculus Rift, Rift s, Quest, Quest 2 and Quest 3, Pico Neo 3, Pico 4, Pico 4 pro
  • Additional Notes: VR Only
